bioconda.name: bioconductor-crimage
bioconda.summary: CRImage a package to classify cells and calculate tumour cellularity

biotools.summary: CRImage provides functionality to process and analyze images, in particular to classify cells in biological images. Furthermore, in the context of tumor images, it provides functionality to calculate tumour cellularity.
